name: Complejidad del Fondo
algorithm: Background Complexity — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes background complexity patterns across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Espacial Complexity Medición**: Background regions (separated from foreground subjects via segmentation) are analyzed for spatial complexity using local entropy, edge density, and texture measures. Each frame's background complexity is quantified as a scalar feature.

2. **Temporal Complexity Estabilidad**: Background complexity should remain stable in static-camera scenarios and change smoothly with camera motion. The temporal signal of background complexity is analyzed for anomalous variations — deepfake generation often introduces subtle background fluctuations as the generator's attention resources are concentrated on face regions.

3. **Foreground - Background Complexity Correlación**: In authentic video, foreground and background share the same imaging pipeline (lens, sensor, compression), producing correlated quality characteristics. Deepfakes may show a complexity mismatch — highly detailed generated faces against backgrounds with different compression or quality characteristics.

4. **Frecuencia Domain Background Análisis**: The power spectral density of background regions is computed per frame. Natural backgrounds maintain consistent spectral characteristics across frames. AI-generated backgrounds may show spectral instability — frame-to-frame variations in frequency content that don't correspond to physical scene changes.

5. **Complexity Límite Detección**: The spatial boundary between foreground subject and background is examined for complexity transitions. Authentic video shows smooth complexity gradients at this boundary. Deepfake composites may produce abrupt complexity transitions coinciding with face-swap boundaries, revealing the manipulation region.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante background complexity analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
